intro: Introducing the Centiguard 560 Fire Safe, a secure space for your vital documents. Equipped with cutting-edge fire resistance and robust security features, it safeguards your important papers from fire, theft, and tampering.

features.title: Ultrakey double locking mechanism
features.text: Two locks are better than one. The Ultrakey double lock offers superior security, providing dual protection and ensuring that your belongings stay safe with trusted reliability.

features.title: 3-way live shooting bolt
features.text: Unmatched security with a 3-way live shooting bolt system—two front bolts, one top, and one bottom, reinforced with rear fixed bolts for comprehensive protection from unauthorized access.In addition, the safe is reinforced by 2 Rear Fixed Shooting Bolts.

features.title: Fire resistant safe certified by ECB-S
features.text: Fireproof peace of mind. Certified by ECB-S, this safe offers 120 minutes of fire resistance, ensuring your documents remain protected even in extreme conditions.

features.title: Double-walled body & door
features.text: Constructed with a double-walled body and filled with fire-resistant material, this safe slows down heat transfer, keeping your documents safe and secure during a fire.

features.title: Advanced snap shut mechanism
features.text: Effortless security. The advanced snap-shut mechanism ensures a secure and durable door closure, enhancing safety while making access easier and more efficient.

features.title: Removable shelf for customizable storage
features.text: Organize your valuables with flexibility. The removable shelf lets you adjust your storage space to fit your needs, providing a customizable solution for your most precious items.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
